title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: check_rule removed from Fragment::from_bytes
description:
The old `Fragment::from_bytes` called `check_rule(data[0])?` to validate that the rule ID is one of `RULE_ID_A_TO_B` (120) or `RULE_ID_B_TO_A` (121). The new implementation has no rule ID validation at all - any `data[0]` value is silently accepted, including unsupported or invalid rule IDs.

`check_rule` is still defined (line ~90) but never called from `from_bytes`. This also applies to `Ack::from_bytes_for` which similarly no longer validates the rule ID.

Affected file: `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` lines 167-197.
